title: ndscape: a structural map of the nested dichotomy space
abstract: arXiv:2610.18050v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Nested dichotomies (NDs) reduce multiclass classification to a tree of binary classifiers. Tree structure can change accuracy, bias, and variance, but the full space of structures has not been mapped in aggregate. We introduce ndscape, a two-dimensional mapping of ND structures based on depth-weighted structural tokens. We use this embedding to conduct what is, to our knowledge, the first bias-variance analysis across the ND structure space. In simulations with 6 to 10 classes, NDs with similar tree structures exhibit similar squared bias, variance, and squared probability loss, regardless of whether the binary classifier is logistic regression or a decision tree. Variance, however, follows mean root-to-leaf depth when logistic regression is used at each node, so flatter, more balanced NDs are more stable, whereas with decision-tree node models, variance is not associated with depth and differs little across ND structures. translated_title: ndscape：嵌套二分法空间的结构地图
translated_abstract: 嵌套二分法（Nested Dichotomies，NDs）将多类别分类问题简化为一棵由二元分类器组成的树。树结构可以影响准确率、偏差和方差，但完整的结构空间尚未被系统性地绘制。我们提出了ndscape，一种基于深度加权结构标记的ND结构二维映射方法。我们利用这一嵌入方法进行了据我们所知首次跨越ND结构空间的偏差-方差分析。在6到10个类别的模拟实验中，具有相似树结构的ND表现出相似的平方偏差、方差和平方概率损失，无论节点使用的二元分类器是逻辑回归还是决策树。然而，当每个节点使用逻辑回归时，方差遵循平均根到叶深度的规律，因此更平坦、更平衡的ND结构更加稳定；而当节点使用决策树模型时，方差与深度无关，且在不同ND结构之间差异很小。在六个数据（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 提出了ndscape——一种基于深度加权结构标记的嵌套二分法结构二维映射方法，并首次对ND结构空间进行了偏差-方差分析，发现当节点使用逻辑回归时，更平坦、更平衡的树结构方差更小、更稳定，而使用决策树节点时方差与结构深度无关。
en_tdlr: We introduce ndscape, a two-dimensional mapping of nested dichotomy structures based on depth-weighted structural tokens, and conduct the first bias-variance analysis across the ND structure space, showing that flatter and more balanced NDs exhibit lower variance and greater stability when logistic regression is used at each node, while variance is unrelated to depth with decision-tree node models.
